summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the repurchase of 1,000,000 ordinary shares on 24 July 2026 at a volume-weighted average price of 113.4169 pence per share, as part of an existing buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. The shares were purchased via Goldman Sachs International and will be cancelled. This is an ordinary-course open-market buyback, not a tender offer or issuer self-tender, but qualifies as a capital return special situation. The programme reduces outstanding equity and returns cash to shareholders. Watch for ongoing buyback pace and any updates on programme size or extension.
